id: title:adamleithp:use slack logo for slack task origin badge

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Slack-specific SVG branding and conditional rendering for Slack origin status badges in the Slack App or task status vocabulary.
review.reason: The supplied hunks demonstrate a localized, bounded change: P1.F3.H1 adds Slack brand-colored SVG paths, P1.F2.H1 imports the SlackMark component, and P1.F2.H3 implements conditional rendering to use SlackMark instead of a generic icon when the origin is Slack. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement for Slack-related status visualization. No broader systemic changes,
review.uncertainty: The supplied chunk P1 is not complete; this score relies only on the provided hunks and cannot account for potential dependencies or broader context outside P1.

observations.limitations: All supplied hunks are from P1, which is not a complete chunk. No score can be assigned.
